subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

The police told the agitators to back in, else they would lathi-charge.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect phrase "**to back in**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**to back off**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• The verb "**back in**" is not appropriate in this context.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The police told the agitators to back off, else they would lathi-charge."*
